summary: In whitespace-insensitive mode, (?x)[ / - ] incorrectly fails to parse because lookahead sees the space after '-' instead of the closing bracket. The parser treats '-' as a range operator, consumes ']' as its endpoint, and reports an unclosed character class. The fix uses whitespace-aware lookahead so the trailing '-' is recognized as literal. Reversing the two lookahead calls restores the faulty behavior while preserving the regression test added by the fix. No tests were executed.
